fast_connect_button.option.ignored_butto: List of translation keys of buttons which will be ignored during 'anchor' button picking
Title screen reopening is required for this list to apply during configuration
fast_connect_button.option.un_replaceabl: List of translation keys of buttons which can't be replaced by 'fast connect button'
fast_connect_button.option.un_moveable_b: List of translation keys of buttons which can't be moved by fast connect button
fast_connect_button.option.anchor_button: The button against which or with which fast connect button will interact
fast_connect_button.option.button_place_: Action done by fast connect button with anchor button
Side on which fast connect button will be relative to anchor button
fast_connect_button.option.button_place_: Place - will place fast connect button next to anchor button on left or right
Move - will place fast connect button in empty space of shrunk anchor button on left or right
Replace - anchor button will be replaced by fast connect button
fast_connect_button.option.button_type.d: How fast connect button will look
Text - on button will be placed customized text
Icon - on button will be drawn sprite, that can be changed with resource pack and button size will be locked at 20 by 20
